newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast spot products extend gains Friday.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast spot products extend gains Friday.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices, which reflect what dealers charge at the pipeline, firmed Friday, as traders focused on lower supply, players said.

CARB regular unleaded gasoline rose 1.50 cents a gallon for the second straight day Friday, boosting prices 10 percent for the week after reports showed lower inventories. CARB unleaded gasoline traded between 71/72 cents a gallon in Los Angeles.
Premium, or octane, gasoline stood $0.07 a gallon higher than regular grade.
The September gasoline contract price rose 2.27 cents a gallon to 65.07 cents.
Other products, including CARB diesel, rose between one and two cents.
